stampLocations.name: Stamp location
stampLocations.description:
Airport notes:  Runway 33 power line at threshold (called out in the A/FD) is buried greater than width of runway between two lighted telephone poles. It does not pose an obstacle issue when landing to the northwest.

Owner advises that landing Runway 7 is subject to significant turbulence in windy conditions due to proximity of hangars either side of Runway 7 approach. Recommends touchdown aim point east of Runway 15-33. Runway 15/33 to east end of Runway 7 approximately 1,100 feet remaining (designated as emergency purposes only in A/FD).

Stamp Location: Mailbox with stamp inside mounted on white building at south end of airfield on west side of road.  Please see photos.
